summary.ja: 右辺を2つの部分流に分け、全刻みずつ順に合成する1次の時間積分法。Strangとの公式・交換子・局所と大域の誤差・非可換な小例を比較する。
summary.en: First-order integration by composing two full subflows. Compare formulas, commutators, local/global errors and a small noncommuting example with Strang splitting.

code_mapping_scope: Reading and a fixed two-component exact-flow illustration; no general solver distribution or common execution-registry mapping. Existing Strang reaction-diffusion runs retain their original method bindings.

references.label: H. F. Trotter (1959). On the product of semi-groups of operators.
references.scope: AMS bibliographic record checked. Original semigroup product-limit reference; no audit of unbounded-operator hypotheses. Finite-dimensional order calculations are derived in the chapter.

references.label: E. Hairer (2010). Geometric Numerical Integration, Lecture2.
references.scope: Author-hosted Lecture 2, section 5, printed pp.12–14, equations (23)–(27), and exact versus numerical subflows: Lie–Trotter, symmetric second-order composition and separable Hamiltonians. Selected passages, not a full-lecture audit.

assumptions: Autonomous additive initial-value problem with sufficiently smooth subflows on a fixed finite time interval.
The stated global order requires stability and sufficiently small steps.
Use exact subflows or subsolvers with sufficient order and compatible boundaries; symmetric subsolvers are needed for time symmetry.
assumptions_ja: 自律的で加法的な初期値問題。固定した有限時間区間で部分流と解に十分な滑らかさがある。
表示した大域次数には安定性と十分小さい刻みが必要。
厳密流または必要な次数・境界整合性を持つ部分ソルバーを用いる。時間対称性には対称な部分ソルバーも必要。
units: h has time units; F and G have units of state/time. For linear systems hA and hB are dimensionless. The oscillator illustration is nondimensional.
units_ja: hは時間、FとGは状態/時間の単位。線形系ではhAとhBが無次元。教材の振動子は全変数を無次元化。
boundary_conditions: None for the two-component ODE. PDEs need compatible stage boundary data; inhomogeneous or time-dependent boundaries can reduce order.
boundary_conditions_ja: 2成分ODEに空間境界条件はない。PDEでは部分問題・段階の境界値を整合させる。非同次・時間依存境界では次数低下を確認。

limitations.ja: 滑らかな有限次元の例の次数を、衝撃波・硬いPDE・一般境界へ保証しない。厳密な部分流でも合成の安定性制約は残る。教材例スクリプトは汎用ソルバー配布版ではない。
limitations.en: The smooth finite-dimensional illustration does not validate shocks, stiff PDEs or general boundaries. Exact subflows do not remove composition stability restrictions. The illustration script is not a general solver release.

metadata_review.level: method-specific reading and finite-dimensional exact-flow illustration; source access recorded individually
